info.title: Calix Support Cloud
info.description: Authentication: HTTP Basic. Calix Support Cloud (Calix Cloud) manages TR-069/CWMP-based broadband CPE devices and their subscribers, provisioning records, and device groups for broadband service providers.

get.description: Retrieve all devices, or a single device matched by serial number, MAC address, registration ID, or WAN IP address. With no query parameters, returns a JSON array of all devices with no filtering or limit/offset. Use `limit`/`skip` to page through large result sets.

parameters.name: serialNumber
parameters.description: The device serial number as reported in the TR-69 INFORM. For most Calix devices, this is the FSAN Serial Number starting with CXNK, not the Manufacturing Serial Number.

parameters.name: macAddress
parameters.description: The hardware MAC address as reported in the TR-69 INFORM, in the format 00:11:22:33:44:55

parameters.name: registrationId
parameters.description: The Calix ONT Registration ID (aka RONTA) as programmed locally on the device.

parameters.name: ipAddress
parameters.description: The WAN IP address as reported by TR-69 INFORM. If STUN is active, this searches the device's WAN IP, not the STUN binding IP.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of records to return (1-500). Default 100.

parameters.name: skip
parameters.description: Offset, in number of records, to skip from the beginning of the returned values. Default 0.

serialNumber.description: FSAN serial number as reported in the TR-69 INFORM.

get.description: Retrieve all subscribers, or a single/list of subscribers matched by internal customId, name, phone, or email. With no query parameters, returns a JSON array of all subscribers with no filtering or limit/offset.

parameters.description: The customId value, displayed as "Subscriber ID" in Calix Support Cloud. Must match exactly.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The subscriber's top-level "name" value. Must match exactly, and may return multiple matches.

parameters.name: phone
parameters.description: Phone number. May match multiple subscribers, as phone number is not required to be unique.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Email address. May match multiple subscribers, as email is not required to be unique.

put.description: Update subscriber details: first retrieve the subscriber record, then PUT the full record back with your changes, with all other elements intact. post.description: Perform a single TR-069/CWMP operation (GetParameterValues, GetParameterNames, SetParameterValues, AddObject, DeleteObject, Reboot, or FactoryReset) against a device, identified by exactly one key in cpeIdentifier. This triggers a Connection Request to the device, which times out after 15 seconds and 3 attempts (Reboot/FactoryReset may take minutes to complete). Where a Provisioning Record field covers the same configuration, Calix recommends using the Provisioning Record instead, since raw data model changes do not persist across a factory reset.

schema.description: A single TR-069/CWMP operation performed against a device via a Connection Request.

cpeIdentifier.description: Identifies the target device by exactly one of its keys.

parameterNames.description: TR-069 data model object paths to retrieve (GetParameterValues) or a single path to list children of (GetParameterNames uses parameterPath instead).

parameterPath.description: TR-069 data model path to list child parameter names of (GetParameterNames).

parameterValues.description: Map of TR-069 data model object path to the value to set (SetParameterValues).

objectName.description: Full TR-069 data model object path, with a trailing dot (AddObject/DeleteObject).

200.description: Operation result; shape varies by operation. Some operations (SetParameterValues, Reboot, FactoryReset) return no body on success.

schema.description: Shape varies by operation. GetParameterValues/GetParameterNames return the requested data model section; AddObject returns newObjectIndex; SetParameterValues/Reboot/FactoryReset return no body on success.

get.description: Retrieve all Static Group Membership records, or those matching a device (a device can belong to more than one static group, so multiple records may be returned even for a single device).

parameters.description: If present, return only Discovered devices (those which have successfully checked in to the ACS).

parameters.description: If present, return only devices which have not checked in to the ACS.
